question: Should CodexBar permanently expose per-provider confetti palette editing and require curated palettes in every provider descriptor?
rationale: This adds both a new user-facing settings surface and an ongoing provider-maintenance contract; implementation correctness cannot establish whether that complexity belongs in the product.

options.title: Keep branded defaults only
options.body: Retain automatic provider-specific palettes but remove the override persistence and editor to minimize permanent settings complexity.

options.title: Land defaults and editor
options.body: Accept branded defaults and per-provider local overrides as an intentional permanent customization surface.

options.title: Keep randomized confetti
options.body: Decline provider branding and preserve the current randomized celebration behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep branded defaults only
recommendation.body: Retain automatic provider-specific palettes but remove the override persistence and editor to minimize permanent settings complexity.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and direct PR timeline participation make this the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
